jobs.description:
Compensation & Location

Location:
Torrance, CA
Pay Range:
$54.00 – $61.00 per hour (based on experience and internal equity)
Schedule:
Full-time, contract; long-term opportunity
Work Type:
4 days/week on site; 1 day/week remote
Benefits:
Health, Vision, Dental, Life Insurance, 401k, Continuing and on-demand education

📍 Must be willing to work onsite in Torrance, CA (LA County)

‼️ ONLY W2 – NO CORP to CORP – NO 3rd Parties

✅ Sponsorship is available for this role

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst / CDP Developer
to support enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) operations, improve data quality, and deliver scalable data solutions across large customer and event datasets. This role blends advanced SQL development, CDP integration, workflow orchestration, and production data troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in customer data platforms, advanced SQL engineering, Python automation, and cloud data environments
, along with experience supporting production data pipelines and customer data privacy requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Development

Analyze customer data, event streams, and large-scale datasets to generate insights
Develop and optimize advanced SQL queries across Presto, Hive, and NoSQL environments
Use Python for data processing, automation, API integrations, and workflow support
Perform exploratory data analysis and anomaly detection
Document data processes, business rules, and workflows

CDP & Pipeline Operations

Support CDP workflow orchestration (Digdag, TD Workflows, or similar tools)
Monitor and enhance data quality frameworks and observability pipelines
Maintain CI/CD and Git-based version control for data code and documentation
Support end-to-end data lifecycle from ingestion to activation

Troubleshooting & Production Support

Diagnose data pipeline failures and workflow issues
Perform root cause analysis using logs and monitoring tools
Support production job monitoring, data validation, and output verification
Implement fixes and reliability improvements

Data Governance & Compliance

Ensure adherence to privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, PII handling)
Support identity resolution, schema design, and profile unification

What You’ll Be Working On

Customer Data Platform integrations and pipeline operations
Large-scale customer and event data processing
Data quality, automation, and workflow optimization
Cross-functional data solutions supporting CRM, marketing, and analytics teams

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
8+ years combined experience in data analysis, data engineering, or data operations
Advanced SQL development and query optimization (Presto, Hive, NoSQL environments)
Experience working with Customer Data Platforms and CRM data integrations
Strong Python experience for data automation and APIs
Cloud data platform familiarity (AWS preferred)
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Digdag, TD Workflows, or similar)
Experience supporting production data environments
Experience with data quality frameworks, monitoring, and alerting
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Skills

Experience with Treasure Data CDP or similar platforms (Informatica, Adobe, Salesforce CDP, Tealium, mParticle)
Experience with data modeling, identity resolution, and profile unification
Experience with CI/CD and Git-based workflows
Strong privacy and compliance experience (GDPR, CCPA, PII handling)
3+ years of Big 4 consulting experience (preferred)
Stable work history within large enterprise organizations

jobs.title: Federal Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Position:
Federal Data Analyst

Location:
Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do

Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements

What We're Looking For

0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week

Qualifications

Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

jobs.title: Lead Consultant Data Analyst
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Consultant Data Analyst based in United States.

This role combines advanced data analysis with technical leadership and mentorship within a collaborative consulting environment. You will translate complex datasets into actionable insights that help clients make informed strategic decisions. The position involves designing reliable data models, optimizing analytical solutions, and strengthening data quality and accessibility. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals. As a senior member of the team, you will also guide junior analysts and communicate findings to executive audiences. The role offers an opportunity to influence data strategy while contributing to complex client engagements and continuous innovation.

Accountabilities

Lead the analysis and interpretation of complex data to generate actionable insights and support strategic business decisions.
Mentor and coach junior data analysts, supporting their technical development and professional growth.
Partner with stakeholders to define data-driven solutions that align analytical initiatives with business objectives.
Design, implement, and optimize robust data models and analytical architecture to support business needs.
Develop advanced SQL queries for efficient data extraction, transformation, analysis, and performance optimization.
Lead the creation and optimization of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using appropriate analytical tools.
Promote strong practices in data governance, data quality, security, and analytical reliability.
Identify and support the adoption of new data analysis tools, technologies, and methodologies.
Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to improve data pipelines, accessibility, and analytical capabilities.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior and executive stakeholders.
Lead Agile data analysis initiatives and help manage priorities and backlogs in alignment with broader business strategy.

Requirements

6+ years of experience in data analysis or a related analytical field.
Expert-level SQL skills, including advanced querying, data transformation, and query optimization.
Extensive experience with data visualization and business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
Strong understanding of cloud analytics technologies and platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
Proven ability to apply statistical techniques to identify trends, generate insights, and support business decisions.
Experience leading teams or mentoring junior analysts, with the ability to provide technical guidance and constructive feedback.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous or complex environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting analytical findings to senior stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and backlog management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Ability to develop and present executive-level reports, insights, and recommendations.
Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional technical and business teams.

Benefits

Base salary range of $125,000–$182,000 USD.
Annual bonus eligibility based on shared organizational goals and objectives.
Flexible distributed work environment, including support for home-office and client-site work.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with multiple plan options.
Employer-contributed health savings account options, infertility coverage, and orthodontia benefits.
8 weeks of parental leave.
Discounted pet insurance.
Care.com membership with 3 emergency backup child or elder care days annually.
15 days of paid vacation, 6 federal holidays, and 4 floating holidays.
Technology program offering a choice of Mac or PC equipment, with computer replacement after three years and the option to keep the original device.
$25 monthly internet reimbursement.
3 paid professional development days annually, including support for classes, conferences, and professional certifications.
Wellness initiatives and access to Headspace, Talkspace, and mental health coverage through medical plans.

Job Summary

About this role

Reporting to the Director of Behavioral Health, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the group therapy program. The goal of this role is to deliver a patient experience that is trauma-informed, patient-centered, evidence-based, and of the highest quality.

Essential Job Functions

Create and maintain the unit's group therapy schedule, ensuring it is implemented on a daily basis as designed.
Develop, update, and coordinate the group therapy program schedule by utilizing the skills and expertise of all disciplines involved in patient care.
Innovate, develop, and introduce evidence-based group programming that reflects the needs of patients.
Ensure all group therapy and alternative-to-group documentation is completed accurately and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
Attend Treatment Team meetings to provide updates on patients' clinical presentation, skills assessment, and participation in group therapy, and provide clinical consultation as appropriate.
Develop and maintain a Group Resource Manual that includes group descriptions, goals, methods, and resources.
Participate in quality improvement projects related to group programming and other initiatives as assigned.
Provide supervision and oversight of interns, when education and experience permit.
Provide group therapy training for unit staff as directed.
Maintain and support patients' rights to care, privacy, and respect.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

Master's degree in Education, Counseling, Expressive Therapy, Art Therapy, Occupational Therapy, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field preferred.

Experience

Minimum of one (1) year of experience providing individual and/or group therapy.
Inpatient behavioral health experience preferred.

Licensure and/or Certification

Current Massachusetts licensure in specialty preferred.
BLS Healthcare Provider certification required.
CPI certification within 30 days of hire required.

Skills

Group and individual assessment skills.
Strong communication skills.
Critical thinking skills.
Organizational skills.
Computer skills.
Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
Ability to maintain confidential information.

# Remote Project Coordinator

## About the Role

JM Services and Consulting, LLC is seeking a talented and motivated Remote Project Coordinator to manage and coordinate projects for clients across various industries. The role involves working closely with consultants and clients to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.

This is a part-time, remote position offering flexibility and the opportunity to work from home. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating projects, communicating with clients, and supporting consultants.

## Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate and manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables.

* Communicate with clients to understand project requirements and expectations.

* Collaborate with consultants to develop project plans and strategies.

* Monitor project progress and identify potential issues or risks.

* Ensure project tasks are completed on time and within budget.

* Conduct project meetings and provide regular updates to clients and team members.

* Maintain project documentation and keep project files organized and up to date.

* Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and effectiveness.

* Assist with project budgeting and cost tracking.

* Provide project support to consultants and clients as needed.

## Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, project management, or a related field.

* 2+ years of experience in project coordination or project management.

* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

* Proficiency in project management software and Microsoft Office Suite.

## Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working remotely.

* PMP certification.

## Skills & Competencies

* Project coordination

* Project management

* Project planning

* Timeline and resource coordination

* Client communication

* Team collaboration

* Risk identification

* Budget and cost tracking

* Project documentation

* Organization and time management

* Process improvement

* Microsoft Office Suite

* Project management software

* Written and verbal communication

* Independent work

## Education & Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field required.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in project coordination or project management required.

* Remote work experience is preferred.

## Work Arrangement & Schedule

* **Work Arrangement:** Remote / Work From Home

* **Employment Type:** Part-time

* **Location:** Santa Fe Springs, California, United States

* **Schedule:** Flexible; specific weekly hours are not stated.

## Compensation & Benefits

* **Compensation:** $28.00–$33.00 per hour.

* Work-from-home arrangement.

* Growth opportunities.

* Supportive and collaborative team environment.

## Compliance / Additional Information

* Employer: JM Services and Consulting, LLC.

* The position involves coordinating projects for the company's clients and collaborating with consultants and internal team members.

Position:
Federal Data Analyst

Location:
Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do

Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements

What We're Looking For

0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week

Qualifications

Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply

Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents

Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Consultant Data Analyst based in United States.

This role combines advanced data analysis with technical leadership and mentorship within a collaborative consulting environment. You will translate complex datasets into actionable insights that help clients make informed strategic decisions. The position involves designing reliable data models, optimizing analytical solutions, and strengthening data quality and accessibility. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and data scientists to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals. As a senior member of the team, you will also guide junior analysts and communicate findings to executive audiences. The role offers an opportunity to influence data strategy while contributing to complex client engagements and continuous innovation.

Accountabilities

Lead the analysis and interpretation of complex data to generate actionable insights and support strategic business decisions.
Mentor and coach junior data analysts, supporting their technical development and professional growth.
Partner with stakeholders to define data-driven solutions that align analytical initiatives with business objectives.
Design, implement, and optimize robust data models and analytical architecture to support business needs.
Develop advanced SQL queries for efficient data extraction, transformation, analysis, and performance optimization.
Lead the creation and optimization of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using appropriate analytical tools.
Promote strong practices in data governance, data quality, security, and analytical reliability.
Identify and support the adoption of new data analysis tools, technologies, and methodologies.
Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to improve data pipelines, accessibility, and analytical capabilities.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for senior and executive stakeholders.
Lead Agile data analysis initiatives and help manage priorities and backlogs in alignment with broader business strategy.

Requirements

6+ years of experience in data analysis or a related analytical field.
Expert-level SQL skills, including advanced querying, data transformation, and query optimization.
Extensive experience with data visualization and business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI.
Strong understanding of cloud analytics technologies and platforms such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
Proven ability to apply statistical techniques to identify trends, generate insights, and support business decisions.
Experience leading teams or mentoring junior analysts, with the ability to provide technical guidance and constructive feedback.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in ambiguous or complex environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting analytical findings to senior stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and backlog management tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Ability to develop and present executive-level reports, insights, and recommendations.
Proficiency in Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
Strong collaborative skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional technical and business teams.

Benefits

Base salary range of $125,000–$182,000 USD.
Annual bonus eligibility based on shared organizational goals and objectives.
Flexible distributed work environment, including support for home-office and client-site work.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance with multiple plan options.
Employer-contributed health savings account options, infertility coverage, and orthodontia benefits.
8 weeks of parental leave.
Discounted pet insurance.
Care.com membership with 3 emergency backup child or elder care days annually.
15 days of paid vacation, 6 federal holidays, and 4 floating holidays.
Technology program offering a choice of Mac or PC equipment, with computer replacement after three years and the option to keep the original device.

3 paid professional development days annually, including support for classes, conferences, and professional certifications.

## About the Role

JM Services and Consulting, LLC is seeking a talented and motivated Remote Project Coordinator to manage and coordinate projects for clients across various industries. The role involves working closely with consultants and clients to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.

This is a part-time, remote position offering flexibility and the opportunity to work from home. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating projects, communicating with clients, and supporting consultants.

* Ensure project tasks are completed on time and within budget.

* Conduct project meetings and provide regular updates to clients and team members.
